resources.string: ① Allow display over other apps
How much the pet shakes when you type. \"None\" just switches images without moving.
When ON, the pet appears automatically whenever you open another app. When OFF, it only shows after tapping button ③.
When ON, taps pass through to the app underneath and the pet can\'t be dragged.
Used whenever you haven\'t added any custom images in the Images tab.
Android doesn\'t allow apps to change their own icon after install. Instead, you can add a shortcut with an image you pick to the home screen. Use that shortcut to open the app.
Pick an image and add to home screen
This device doesn\'t support adding icons to the home screen
Shown when you\'re not typing. With several, one is picked at random each time it goes idle. If empty, the 1st typing image (or the built-in color) is used.
While typing, images switch 1st → 2nd → 3rd… and loop back to the 1st. Add alternates to a number and one of them is picked at random each time that number comes up.

When you type a registered character, one of its images is shown at random. You can assign several characters to one image (e.g. \"a\" and \"u\" for a gloomy face). Full-width and half-width are treated as different characters. Nothing is saved or sent \u2014 it only checks the few characters right before where you typed, in the moment.
Save your images (idle, typing, character triggers) and built-in color per character and switch between them. Edits in the Images tab apply to the character marked \"in use\".
You can\'t delete the last character
The faint shadow under the pet. Turn it off if it looks odd with your transparent images.
